components.name: Socket head cap screw ISO 4762, M2 to M8
components.sim_model: No schematic block by default (structural part). Contributes mass only. Mass is computed analytically from the generated head and shank volumes times density; the mesh is not used because procedural unions are not watertight. Dropping a screw through coaxial hole anchors on two parts proposes a fixed mate between them, and a fixed mate merges them into one rigid body (PLAN decision 5). Bolt preload is out of scope for v1.

components.name: Deep-groove ball bearing: 625, 688(ZZ), 608, 6000 to 6005
components.sim_model: Rotational friction between the inner and outer ring (the outer ring is usually tied to mechanical ground). Torque: tau = M*tanh(w_rel/w_s) + c*w_rel, with M = 0.5*mu*P*d (SKF simplified model: roughly P near 0.1C, good lubrication). P is the radial load in N, from a 3D gravity binding or a user parameter. d is the bore in m. w_s is a small smoothing speed (e.g. 0.1 rad/s) so Newton converges at w = 0, where Coulomb friction is undefined. Rating checks (warnings only): P > C0 gives a static overload warning; L10 = (C/P)^3 * 1e6 revolutions is shown for information. Shields (ZZ/2Z) add negligible torque. Contact seals (2RS) add unknown seal torque, so expose it as a user parameter. Example: 608 at P = 100 N gives M = 0.6 N*mm.

components.name: Linear ball bushing LM8UU (8 mm)
components.sim_model: Axial friction between the bushing and the shaft: F = mu*P*tanh(v_rel/v_s) + c*v_rel. P is the radial load from a 3D gravity binding or a parameter. Warning if P > C0. Optional life L = (C/P)^3 * 50 km (ball-type linear rule; check the vendor's basis). The 3D side is a prismatic mate along the shaft axis; rotation about the shaft is also free (cylindrical behaviour), so the library should offer revolute + prismatic, or rely on a second shaft.

components.name: Lead screw Tr8x8(P2), 4-start (T8), with Tr8x2 variant
components.sim_model: Rotational-to-translational transformer, referenced to mechanical ground (the frame). Kinematics: v_nut = (lead/(2*pi)) * w_screw; for lead 8 mm that is 1.2732e-3 m/rad. Forward drive: tau_screw = F_nut*lead/(2*pi*eta), with eta = tan(lambda)/tan(lambda + phi'), phi' = atan(mu/cos 15 deg) for the 30 degree trapezoidal flank, lambda = atan(lead/(pi*d2)). Back-drive: tau = F*lead*eta_b/(2*pi), with eta_b = tan(lambda - phi')/tan(lambda). If lambda <= phi' the screw is self-locking and the nut is constrained to v = 0 against back-driving loads, with the reaction going to ground. Choosing between forward and back-drive is a sign test on power flow; Newton handles it with a smoothed switch. Tr8x8: lambda = 19.99 deg; eta = 0.749 / 0.661 / 0.589 at mu = 0.10 / 0.15 / 0.20; not self-locking. Tr8x2: lambda = 5.20 deg; self-locking for mu >= 0.10.

components.name: Spur gear, module 1, 20 degree involute, z = 10 to 60
components.sim_model: Each gear exposes its shaft port. When two gears are placed in mesh, the app creates a 'gear pair' block (2 rotational ports, frame = ground): w2 = -(z1/z2)*w1 (external mesh reverses direction), tau2 = -(z2/z1)*eta*tau1 in the driving direction (ratio z2/z1). eta is a parameter, default 0.98 (unsourced). Mesh validation: |a_3D - m*(z1+z2)/2| <= tolerance, where a_3D is the bound distance between the two bore axes; otherwise the diagnostic 'gears not in mesh'. Example: z1 = 20, z2 = 40 gives a = 30 mm and ratio 2.

components.name: Helical compression spring (parametric)
components.sim_model: Static force between the ends: F = k*(L0 - L) for Lc <= L <= L0, else 0 (no contact). L is the 3D distance between the two seat anchors, supplied by an anchor-distance binding (Phase 12). Spring rate k = G*d^4/(8*D^3*n_a). In a v/F steady-state network a spring is the inductor analogue (a short at DC), so it cannot be stamped as an admittance; its force has to come from geometry as a force source. Warnings: L < Lc (coil bind); L > L0 (spring loose).

params.name: rate formula
params.value: k = G*d^4 / (8*D^3*n_a) (N/mm with d and D in mm, G in N/mm^2)

components.name: Pneumatic mini cylinder ISO 6432, double acting, bore 10/12/16/20/25
components.sim_model: Fluid-to-translational transducer. Force on the rod (extend positive): F = p_a*A_cap - p_b*A_ann (gauge pressures). Flows: Q_a = A_cap*v_rel and Q_b = -A_ann*v_rel, with v_rel = v_rod - v_body. In steady state a cylinder holding a load is stalled: v = 0, Q = 0, so the line pressures equal the supply and F = p*A. This matches the PLAN 11.9 test 'cylinder F = pA'. Breakaway friction is a parameter (default 0; unknown). The rod's prismatic mate (limits 0..stroke) provides the 3D position; end-of-stroke contact can be reported.

components.name: Push-in fitting, straight male connector: tube 4 x M5, tube 6 x R1/8
components.sim_model: Default: ideal connection (both ports on one fluid net, no pressure drop). Optional ISO 6358 restriction using sonic conductance C and critical ratio b (Newton, non-linear). Choked (p2/p1 <= b): Q = C*p1*sqrt(293/T). Subsonic: Q = C*p1*sqrt(1 - ((p2/p1 - b)/(1 - b))^2)*sqrt(293/T). Absolute pressures; Q in ANR, converted to m^3/s. With no flow (stalled actuators) the drop is zero either way.

6 x R1/8 (ref. SMC KQ2H06-01AS): H / D / L / A / M
effective area S
params.value: 4 x M5: 4; 6 x R1/8: 13.1 (nylon tube) / 10.4 (urethane tube)

params.name: sonic conductance from S
params.value: C about S/5 (0.8 for S = 4; 2.1 to 2.6 for 6 mm); Simscape alternative C = 0.128*4S/pi

tube_socket (axial): tube insertion axis with depth metadata

components.notes: The S to C rule of thumb (S = 5*C) is SMC's general conversion from memory, not confirmed for these parts.

components.name: Polyurethane pneumatic tubing 4 mm and 6 mm OD
components.sim_model: Default: ideal connection. Optional linear (laminar, incompressible) resistance R = 128*mu*L/(pi*d^4); per metre of air at 20 C: 1.888e7 (ID 2.5), 1.614e7 (ID 2.6), 2.881e6 (ID 4.0) Pa*s/m^3. This is indicative only: real pneumatic flow is compressible and often turbulent, so the ISO 6358 elements (fittings, valves) dominate when there is flow.

the path is a spline between two port anchors and honours the min bend radius
components.model_source: procedural. TubeGeometry of an annulus swept along a Catmull-Rom or Bezier path between the two snapped fitting anchors (visual only, no collider).
components.default_material: Rubber 1100 kg/m^3 (PLAN.md 6.2) as a stand-in for PU (real PU density unsourced); translucent blue look
components.notes: Steady-state pneumatic networks with dead-ended actuators carry no flow, so tube resistance changes nothing until an exhaust or leak path exists.

components.name: Manual 2/2 ball valve, push-in 4 mm / 6 mm (generic)
components.sim_model: Switchable restriction. Closed: leak conductance only (e.g. 1e-15 m^3/(s*Pa)) to keep the matrix regular. Open: ISO 6358 orifice with C and b, or a linear conductance for simple mode. The 'open' input comes from a data wire, or from a binding to the handle's revolute angle (0 deg closed, 90 deg open; the fraction can scale C).

params.name: derived sonic conductance C
params.value: 4 mm: about 0.58; 6 mm: about 2.1 (assumes b = 0.3 and a 6 to 5 bar gauge test)

params.name: larger brass G1/4 ball valve (alternative preset)

anchors: handle_pivot (axial): revolute mate for the handle part, limits 0 to 90 deg
components.model_source: procedural. Body (box with lathe ends), two push-in collets, and a handle lever as a separate part with a revolute mate.
components.default_material: ABS 1040 kg/m^3 as a stand-in for the PBT housing (low); brass 8500 for the brass preset
components.notes: The item is generic; Festo QH data is used only for flow and pressure reference values.

components.name: Check valve, in-line push-in (generic, 4 / 6 mm)
components.sim_model: Fluid diode: Q = G*softplus(dp - p_crack) in the forward direction (dp = p_in - p_out), reverse leak G_leak. Solved with Newton like the electrical diode. An ISO 6358 C/b orifice can replace the linear G when open.
anchors: flow_direction (axial, arrow glyph from inlet to outlet)
components.model_source: procedural. Lathe body with two collets and a direction-arrow decal.

components.name: Laser diode dot module 650 nm, about 5 mW, dia 6 mm
components.sim_model: Electrical side: a module with a built-in driver, modelled as a smoothed constant-current load, I = I_op*s((V - V_on)/dV) for V >= V_on, where s is a logistic step; or, simplest, R_eq = V_nom/I_op (about 167 ohm at 5 V and 30 mA). Light side: P_out = P_rated*clamp(I/I_op, 0, 1). The beam is emitted along the beam anchor's +Z; the viewport draws a beam line and spot glow when P_out > 0 (visual only). Warning if V exceeds V_max.

params.value: 6 x 10.5 (listings also give 6 x 10 and 6 x 18)

anchors: beam_axis (axial): origin at the lens face, +Z = emission direction
body_axis (axial): for 6 mm clamp or hole mates

components.notes: The KY-008 breakout (3-pin S/+/- on an 18.5 x 15 mm PCB) is a separate variant. It belongs with the electronic-modules catalogue, and its pin S adds a data/electrical enable.

components.name: Plano-convex lens dia 25.4 mm, f = 50 mm, N-BK7 (generic; f parametric)
components.sim_model: Signal block: P_out = T*P_in. Uncoated T = (1 - R)^2 = 0.917, with R = ((n - 1)/(n + 1))^2 = 0.0422 per surface, ignoring absorption. AR-coated T is a parameter. No ray tracing in v1; f is used only to show the focal-point anchor. A later version could scale T by an alignment factor from a 3D binding (angle and offset between the emitter beam axis and the lens optical axis).

gaps: Vendor primary sites (skf.com, hiwin, misumi-ec, festo, smc, gates, thorlabs, openbuilds) were blocked from this container: curl got a 403 from the egress proxy and WebFetch failed DNS. Every value attributed to them came from search-engine extraction of those pages, or from distributor listings. A human should check them against the vendor PDFs before shipping. The worst-supported ones: 6001/6003 ratings, the LM8UU rating, all fitting and valve flow data, and the laser module values.

ISO standard texts (ISO 4762, 4032, 7089, 4026, 53, 54, 6432, 286-2, DIN 103) are paywalled and were not read. Fastener dimensions come from open transcriptions: cq_warehouse (Apache-2.0) and FreeCAD FastenersWB (GPL-2.0-or-later). Ship StudioVD-owned JSON tables with citations; do not copy the GPL FastenersWB or NopSCADlib (GPL-3.0) files. Dimension facts are generally not copyrightable, but this is not legal advice.

Bearing load ratings in cq_warehouse are SKF catalogue data. SKF's terms for redistributing catalogue tables are unknown. Ratings could ship as 'typical' values with a note, or be fetched only as references.

688 is ambiguous: the hobby 688ZZ is 8x16x5 (SKF 628/8-2Z, C 1.33 kN) and the open 618/8 is 8x16x4 (C 0.819 kN). The default is 8x16x5. Distributors also quote 1.25 to 1.6 kN for 688 from other makers.

Missing data: masses and chamfers for 6001-6005, seal (2RS) friction torque, linear-guide seal drag, GT2 belt tensile stiffness and allowable tension, flexible-coupler torsional stiffness and verified rated torque, gear mesh efficiency, ISO 6432 barrel OD and lengths, ball-valve and check-valve body geometry, corner bracket thickness and holes, butt hinge dimensions (no dimensional standard exists), and the laser module turn-on voltage and current.

GT2: the 0.254 mm pitch-line differential and the 1.38 mm belt thickness were not confirmed from Gates primary documents (one table says 1.52 mm). The exact GT2 tooth profile is proprietary, so procedural pulleys use an approximate profile.

Simulation-model gaps: (1) In the PLAN's v/F steady-state formulation a spring is a DC short, so its force must come from an anchor-distance binding (Phase 12). Springs therefore depend on bindings existing. (2) Coulomb friction (bearings, guides, hinge) is undefined at zero speed, so smoothing (tanh) or a stiction model must be chosen. (3) The lead screw forward/back-drive efficiency and self-locking are non-linear and need a smoothed switch. (4) Pneumatics: air is compressible and ISO 6358 orifices are non-linear in absolute pressure. The PLAN's p/Q domain must state that Q is ANR volumetric flow and that pressures are gauge (0 = atmosphere) with an absolute offset inside ISO 6358 elements.

The light domain unit is undecided: W (radiant) vs lm (luminous). The laser module is specified in mW. Converting 650 nm to lumens needs the CIE V(lambda) value at 650 nm (about 0.107, from memory, not sourced here), so the LED/photodiode catalogue must use the same convention.

Kinematics: Rapier has no gear, belt/pulley or screw (helical) coupling joints (from memory of the Rapier joint set, not re-verified here). Gear pairs, pulleys and lead screws are therefore coupled only in the steady-state solve, not in drag/test mode, unless a custom coupling constraint is written. This should be flagged in PLAN Phase 9 or Phase 14.

There is no optical ray tracing in v1. Light coupling between emitter, lens, mirror and sensor goes through schematic wires, not 3D geometry. Alignment-dependent transmission would need a new binding source (angle and offset between two axial anchors).

Procedural geometry built from LatheGeometry, ExtrudeGeometry (shapes with holes) and TubeGeometry avoids a CSG kernel. However, multi-mesh unions are not watertight, so the divergence-theorem mass in PLAN section 2 fails for them. Library parts should carry analytic mass (formula or catalogue massOverrideKg) instead of mesh-derived mass.

FreeCAD-library STEP fallbacks (CC-BY-3.0: 608ZZ, LM8uu, MGN12H/rail, 5x8 coupler, 2020 V-slot, 2020 corner bracket, T8 screw and nut) need per-part author attribution taken from git history. They are simplified (MGN12H is 33 KB) and are not recommended over procedural generation.

The ISO 6432 nose thread for bore 10 (M12x1.25) is inferred from the bore-8 row and was not directly sourced. Some suppliers list a different nose thread for bore 16 (M12x1.25 vs M16x1.5), and Mindman lists a G1/8 port for bore 16 where others list M5.
The air viscosity 1.81e-5 Pa*s, the ISO 286-2 h6 band (0/-9 um) and the ISO 53 root fillet coefficient 0.38 are from memory and were not fetched. They are marked medium or low.
